angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 47,307,600 km at 1222.70 pc = 0.52 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, W Gem: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 1222.7 +/- 143.1 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 1222.7 +/- 143.1 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 0.9723 +/- 0.0282 mas (same row, RUWE 1.23), 34.5 standard errors, is not used
radiusSource: Radius 68 +/- 8 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, W Gem: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 68 +/- 8 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 47,307,600 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5625 +/- 381 K from Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 259, Name='W Gem', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5625 +/- 381 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 259, Name='W Gem', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5625 +/- 381 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186)
surfaceGravitySource: log g 0.92 from 2024A&A...690A.246T, the median of its 2 spectra; the 10 published values span log g 0.52 to 2.25, across which the limb law changes by at most 1.3% of the centre brightness (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A%26A...690A.246T)
spectralTypeSource: SIMBAD, V* W Gem: spectral type F5-G1
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, V* W Gem: main object type cC*, Classical Cepheid Variable

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
